title: Decision Table: Wayfare Pro Status, Review Rating and Registration Grace
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** A Wayfare driver's Pro status, held on the driver's earnings account under the **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** product, together with the rating at the latest rating review on the standing record, bears on the registration grace days: the calendar days after a lapsed vehicle registration's expiry date on which the document hold for it begins.

## Rule

A driver whose earnings account holds Wayfare Pro Platinum, Wayfare Pro Diamond or Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite and whose rating at the latest rating review is at least 4.90 adds 6 days to the registration grace days; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Silver or Wayfare Pro Gold whose rating at the latest rating review is at least 4.80 adds 4 days; any other driver adds none.

Ratings are read as recorded at the latest rating review, to two decimal places.

## Combinations

| Pro status on the earnings account | Latest review rating 4.90 or higher | 4.80 to 4.89 | 4.79 or lower |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | adds 6 | adds 0 | adds 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver or Gold | adds 4 | adds 4 | adds 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | adds 0 | adds 0 | adds 0 |

Both parts of each condition must hold. A Platinum driver rated 4.85 meets neither row's condition, because the 4-day row is for Silver and Gold drivers.

## Hypothetical readings

- Diamond Elite, latest review 4.90: adds 6.
- Gold, latest review 4.95: adds 4.
- Silver, latest review 4.79: adds none.
